pages.text: Check actual task state and leftovers before finishing. Apply only an allowed repair, then run verification and cite fresh evidence. A recommendation alone is not completion.
After interruption, inspect persisted task state. A pending operation is not completed work. Resolve only through the permitted operation and verify the resulting state.
A heartbeat shows process existence, not readiness. Check the task output and preserve unrelated state while applying a repair. Verify again before declaring completion.
